mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_PERSON_TAG (ID, PERSON_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_REF, STATUS, RULE_ID, BATCH_NO, MATCHED_KEYWORD, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{personId}, #{tagId}, #{source}, #{sourceRef}, #{status}, #{ruleId}, #{batchNo}, #{matchedKeyword}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, PERSON_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_TYPE AS SOURCE, SOURCE_REF, STATUS, RULE_ID, BATCH_NO, MATCHED_KEYWORD, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND SOURCE_REF = #{sourceRef}

SELECT ID, PERSON_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_TYPE AS SOURCE, SOURCE_REF, STATUS, RULE_ID, BATCH_NO, MATCHED_KEYWORD, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT
SELECT DISTINCT PERSON_ID FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE TAG_ID = #{tagId}
SELECT DISTINCT PERSON_ID FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = 'RULE' AND RULE_ID = #{ruleId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PT_PERSON_TAG PT WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR PT.STATUS = #{status})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PT.ID, PT.PERSON_ID, P.NAME AS PERSON_NAME, P.EXTERNAL_ID, PT.TAG_ID, T.NAME AS TAG_NAME, T.CATEGORY AS TAG_CATEGORY, PT.SOURCE_TYPE AS SOURCE, PT.STATUS, PT.MATCHED_KEYWORD, PT.BATCH_NO, E.MATCH_DETAIL, PT.REVIEWED_BY, PT.REVIEWED_AT, PT.CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PT.CREATED_AT DESC, PT.ID) AS RN FROM PT_PERSON_TAG PT JOIN PT_PERSON P ON P.ID = PT.PERSON_ID JOIN PT_TAG_DEFINITION T ON T.ID = PT.TAG_ID LEFT JOIN PT_PERSON_TAG_EVIDENCE E ON E.PERSON_ID = PT.PERSON_ID AND E.TAG_ID = PT.TAG_ID AND E.RULE_SET_ID = PT.RULE_ID AND E.EVIDENCE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR PT.STATUS = #{status}) ) PAGE_DATA WHERE PAGE_DATA.RN > #{offset} AND PAGE_DATA.RN <= #{endRow} ORDER BY PAGE_DATA.RN
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'MANUAL'
DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'REMOTE'
DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = 'RULE' AND RULE_ID = #{ruleId}
DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG WHERE ID = #{id} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'RULE'
